checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: One playable music audio file is delivered
must.why: A 30 s WAV with sound was delivered and a download link given.

must.item: Music sounds upbeat with clear rhythmic pulse
must.why: Audio was not heard or transcribed; only the description claims it.

must.item: Opening establishes music promptly without long silence
must.why: Peak -1 dB and has sound, but the start of the file can't be checked.

must.item: Usable as reel bed without glitches or abrupt cutoff
must.why: Ending and glitches can't be judged from the numbers.

summary: A 30-second WAV with sound was delivered as asked, but the upbeat feel, opening and ending could not be verified.
